mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above the prior quarter's growth rate signals stronger household demand, which raises earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth q/q > prior quarter's growth
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of accelerated consumption growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 6.5% signals labor market tightness that raises wage pressure and inflation expectations, which in turn boosts equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of sustained low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings expectations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained industrial production declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the housing starts index (HOUST) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening residential construction activity, which reduces earnings expectations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained housing starts declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 2% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained rate hikes above 2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 6.5% signals labor market slack that reduces wage pressure and inflation expectations, which in turn lowers equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained high unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of accelerated consumption growth (t-test p > 0.05).
